text_block_list.text:
Her debut race is right around the corner. 
Once that's over, we'll need to set her 
next schedule, but...
choice_data_list: Is there a race you want to enter?
Is there a race you want to enter?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh, no clue. Leaving it to you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

"Though she began holding her head in 
distress... setting concrete goals leads 
to daily motivation and growth."
choice_data_list:
(I'd like her to be mindful of that 
herself if possible.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There might be one, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make it big!!

And just like a cloud floating in the sky, 
she spoke of her fluffy, airy goal.
—And so came the day of the debut race.

Touching her nails, sipping her drink, 
Tosen Jordan remains restless the entire 
time in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: N-No, I haven't!! Not at all...
(Knock knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here you go~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I came to cheer you on! Are your shoulders 
nice and relaxed?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I got a message from City and the others 
too. They said, "It's the real deal, so 
bring home 1st place."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The main event...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Still... what if... ......

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...N-No. It's... nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

"...Sometimes, it's just easier to confide 
in friends."
choice_data_list: I'm stepping outside for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Okey-dokey! Take your time and relax, 
Trainer!
(...*click*)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So, what's up, Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Eek.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm scared, Palmer... The real thing is 
finally here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It's the real deal...! And here I 
thought I could look way cooler than 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even though I told you I was gonna make it 
big, Trainer...! I... I just...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"What if I can't run properly in the real 
thing... just like before I teamed up with 
Trainer...?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...If it's truly just scary and painful, 
it's okay to run away, you know."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah. But that face says 'running away' was 
never an option to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even though you're terrified, don't you 
want to try it out even more?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Show them a stronger me who can run 
properly in the real race too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Because we bust our butts training every 
single day for the races, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then with all the practice we've put in up 
to this day, I wanna seize victory with my 
own two legs!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if you mess up, you can just run 
in a Maiden race next time! That's what 
happened to me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's surprisingly good in its own way! 
Gets you all pumped up, like, "Aight, 
let's do this!" Jordan, wanna give it a 
shot sometime?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That's the exact reason I don't 
wanna lose, though!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, uh oh, did I make you mad? My bad, 
my bad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, carry that feeling straight 
through to the goal. Don't worry, you've 
got this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Both myself and your Trainer are watching 
over you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even if you can't run properly just this 
once, I will always keep cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm your friend. And Trainer 
is..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Even Jordan was convinced this person 
might be alright, weren't they? At least a 
little bit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm heading to the paddock 
now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ……Mm.

And so, Tosen Jordan headed off to her 
debut race.
